title: Little Haunts Club: Spooky Neighbors — Targeted Nine-Page Revision Batch
purpose: Targeted regeneration of nine specific pages from the first Spooky Neighbors set. These pages were selected because full-resolution review identified a concrete defect to fix. The other six pages are intentionally not regenerated.
visual_bible: Original spooky-cute storybook coloring-page art for older children, teens, and adults. Draw crisp black contour lines on pure white paper. Use confident bold outer contours with only a few purposeful inner lines, generous open white coloring regions, clear separation between neighboring objects, and rounded friendly proportions. Reserve solid black for small accents such as pupils and tiny nostrils; large areas of clothing, wings, feathers, furniture, window views, and props remain white inside their outlines. Keep the scene readable at print size, with one focal action and a small number of meaningful supporting details. Any framed art or view through a window has a white background with outlined subjects.
prompt_strategy: Subject and action first, followed by fixed line-art style and specific spatial/physical relationships. Scenes are deliberately constrained to correct observed output defects, not broadened into a new experiment.

pages.label: R01 · replaces original page 02 — Patchwork Monster Builds a Birdhouse
pages.design_rationale: Correct the robot-like face from v1: the main character must read as a soft stitched creature, not a gadget. Keep the birdhouse opening colorable and its support relationship obvious.
pages.qa_focus: Stitched creature face, birdhouse entrance is outlined with a white interior, bird feet on roof, hammer resting on table, broad pumpkin shapes, no electronic-looking screen face.
pages.prompt: A friendly patchwork monster child with a rounded square cloth face, a few stitched panel seams, two small bolts at the neck, and simple overalls carefully builds a birdhouse at a sturdy outdoor workbench.
